summary: F-007 Agent Workflows: Multi-step AI agent pipelines with human checkpoints, workflow editor UI, orchestration service, and pre-built templates
approach: Build a workflow orchestration layer on top of existing agent/workflow APIs. Create type definitions, a service for CRUD+execution, a Zustand slice for client state, and a workflow editor panel. Follow established patterns from Phase 1 (templateService builtin- prefix, intelligenceSlice store pattern). Sequential execution with checkpoint gates between steps.

data_flow.diagram: types -> service -> slice -> panel | service -> agent APIs (agents.ts, intelligence.ts) | service -> workflow APIs (plans.ts, checkpoints.ts)
stages: Types define Workflow, WorkflowStep, WorkflowExecution contracts
Service handles CRUD (load/save/delete workflows) + execution orchestration (step chaining with checkpoint gates)
Slice manages client-side state: workflow list, current execution, step results
Panel provides UI for editing workflows, triggering execution, reviewing step outputs

design_decisions: Form-based step editor (not node-based) — matches existing panel patterns, lower complexity
Builtin workflow templates with `builtin-` prefix — consistent with Phase 1 template pattern
Thin orchestration wrapping existing agent APIs — no new AI capabilities needed
Inline checkpoint UI within workflow panel — approve/modify/reject buttons per step
User workflows stored via Tauri filesystem in app data dir — consistent with template storage

patterns: Zustand AppSlice<T> with set/get pattern (intelligenceSlice.ts reference)
Tauri FS mock with vi.hoisted() for tests
Builtin- prefix for built-in items, UUID for user-created
conventions: TypeScript strict mode, no any casts
